list.title: Conversion sources
list.emptyDescription: Add a partner network whose offers you send traffic to, or your own site that reports its purchases itself.

form.description: Who tells FLOX about conversions: a partner network or your own site.
form.postbackUrlHint: Where FLOX itself sends a request when one of this network's conversions changes status — to an ad source, for example. Leave empty if you need none. Macros like {click_id} and {status} are filled in.
form.currencyHint: When a postback sends an amount without a currency, FLOX takes it to be in this one. Without it, that revenue would be left out of reports.
form.acceptDuplicatesHint: By default FLOX records each status once per click (a repeat purchase once per transaction id) and drops repeats. Some partners re-send the same status on purpose — turn this on only if this network needs it. A status still never moves back to hold.

validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

rowActions.archiveConfirmDescription: Archived networks are hidden from offer/flow pickers going forward. Existing flows that already reference this network keep working. This can be reversed later.

postbackSecret.title: Incoming postback secret
postbackSecret.description: Save it now: the secret is shown once. Give this URL to “{{name}}”.
postbackSecret.urlLabel: URL for the network, with the secret

incoming.title: Incoming postback — for the network
incoming.description: Enter this URL in the network's dashboard: it is how the network tells FLOX about registrations, purchases and rejections.
incoming.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it yourself
incoming.macrosHint: Replace the values in braces with your network's macros (for example click_id={sub1}, revenue={payout}). {secret} is this network's secret.
incoming.secretHint: The secret is shown once, when the network is created. If you did not keep it, get a new one: the old one stops working and the URL in the network's dashboard has to be updated.
incoming.confirmDescription: The old secret stops working at once: postbacks carrying it are refused until you update the URL in the network's dashboard.
incoming.noTrackerTitle: The tracker address is not set
incoming.noTrackerDescription: The platform has no public tracker address (TRACKER_PUBLIC_URL), so FLOX cannot show the URL. Contact the platform administrator.

params.secret: Required. The network's secret — without it the postback is refused.
params.click_id: Required. The FLOX click id: the network gets it in the offer link when that link carries the {click_id} macro.
params.status: Required. The status in the network's terms — it has to be in the mapping below.
params.revenue: The payout, a number with a dot. Without it the conversion carries no money.
params.currency: The amount's currency (USD, EUR…). If it is not sent, FLOX takes this network's payout currency: {{currency}}.
params.txn_id: The network's transaction id. Needed for repeat purchases: without it a second purchase on the same click counts as a duplicate.
params.event_time: When the conversion happened (unix time or ISO 8601). Without it, when the postback arrived.
params.refund_amount: For a refund: how much of the purchase is refunded, in its currency. Without it the refund takes back all that is left of the purchase.
params.refund_id: For a second partial refund of the same order: the refund's own id. Without it a repeated partial refund counts once.

incoming.noStatusesDescription: No network status is mapped to a FLOX status — every postback from this network will be refused.

check.title: Check a postback
check.description: Paste the URL as the network will call it — FLOX answers what it would do with it. Nothing is recorded.
check.hint: Fill in the secret and a real click_id — take one from a test click in the click log. A made-up click_id is checked too, it just matches no click.

explain.unauthorized: The tracker would answer 401: the secret is missing or wrong. Paste the secret you got when the network was created, or get a new one above.
explain.badRequest: The tracker would answer 400: the amount or the event time cannot be read. The network will not retry this request.
explain.success: The conversion would be recorded and attributed to the click.
explain.successUnattributed: The conversion would be recorded, but no click matched — it would count without a campaign until its click is found.
explain.duplicate: This conversion is already recorded for the click: a repeat would not be counted again.
explain.ignored: The postback would be understood but not applied — the click already has a later status.
explain.error: The postback would be refused. The reason is below.

check.currencyAssumed: currency not sent, the network's assumed
check.noRate: no exchange rate for the day — left out of revenue reports
check.nothingRecorded: Dry run: nothing was recorded, nothing was sent to the network.

redepWithoutTxn.lostTitle_one: {{count}} repeat purchase lost: repeat purchases come without txn_id
redepWithoutTxn.lostTitle_other: {{count}} repeat purchases lost: repeat purchases come without txn_id
redepWithoutTxn.lostDescription: Repeat purchases without the network's transaction id over {{days}} days: {{received}}. Without it FLOX cannot tell one purchase from the next on the same click, so every repeat after the first was refused as a duplicate and is missing from revenue and LTV.
redepWithoutTxn.riskDescription: Repeat purchases without the network's transaction id over {{days}} days: {{received}}. None was lost yet, but a second purchase on the same click would be refused as a duplicate.
redepWithoutTxn.fix: Add txn_id to the postback URL in the network's dashboard, with the network's transaction-id macro — for example txn_id={transaction_id}. Purchases already refused are not recovered.

template.label: Affiliate platform
template.hint: On a known platform the incoming URL comes with its macros, and its statuses are mapped when the network is created.
template.urlHint: The URL already carries {{name}}'s macros: paste it into the postback settings there as it is.
template.offerLink: In the offer link at {{name}}, pass FLOX's click id as
template.perGoal: This platform sends one postback per goal and has no status macro: create one postback per goal (registration, first purchase…) with the goal's name in place of REPLACE_GOAL, and map those names below.
template.mappingsCreated: Its status codes were mapped when the network was created — see the statuses below.
template.mappingsError: The network was created, but some of the platform's status mappings were not: add them under Event Mapping.

kind.label: Where conversions come from
kind.partnerHint: A CPA/CPL network whose offers you send traffic to; it reports conversions with a postback.
kind.ownSiteHint: Your own site, shop, service or app reports its leads, purchases and refunds itself — no partner. Its statuses (lead, purchase, repeat_purchase, refund, cancel, spam) are set up for you.

ownSite.title: Conversion URL — for your site
ownSite.description: Your site's server calls this URL when a visitor leaves a lead, pays, buys again or gets a refund.
ownSite.stepLink: Make the offer's link your site with FLOX's click id in it:
ownSite.stepKeep: Keep the click_id on your site (a cookie or the session) until the visitor places an order.
ownSite.stepCall: When an order is created, paid or refunded, your server calls the URL: status — one of the statuses below; revenue — the order's amount; currency — its currency; txn_id — the order's number (repeat purchases need it).
ownSite.serverOnly: Call it from your server only: the URL holds the secret, and anyone could read it in the page's code.
ownSite.secretDescription: Save it now: the secret is shown once. Give this URL to your site's developer — the site's server calls it on leads, purchases and refunds.
ownSite.secretUrlLabel: URL for your site, with the secret
ownSite.urlHint: Replace {click_id}, {amount}, {currency} and {order_id} with the order's values, and status with the right status.

statuses.lead: a lead or sign-up, waiting for payment
statuses.repeat_purchase: the next order of the same customer (with its own txn_id)
statuses.refund: a refund — with the order's txn_id it takes back that order (the first or a repeat one); refund_amount for part of it
statuses.cancel: an order cancelled — takes its revenue back if it was paid

browser.title: Site without a server
browser.description: For a site built in Tilda or another builder: a script on its pages keeps the click id and reports a lead or a purchase — no server needed.
browser.enable: Take conversions from the site's pages
browser.domainsHint: One per line, e.g. shop.example.com — its subdomains count too. Other sites' pages are refused.
browser.everyPage: 1. On every page of the site (keeps the click id):
browser.thankYou: 2. On the thank-you page (reports the purchase; put the order's values in data-revenue, data-currency, data-order, or leave them out):

copy.everyPage: Copy the tag for every page
copy.thankYou: Copy the tag for the thank-you page

browser.jsCall: From your own code: flox("lead") or flox("purchase", { revenue: 1990, currency: "RUB", order: "A-1001" }). Use "lead" for a form, "purchase" for a paid order.
browser.limits: A page can be faked by anyone who opens it, so a page reports only a lead and a purchase, once per click, for a click FLOX recorded, from your domains. Repeat purchases, refunds and cancellations need the server URL above.
